# truenas_vmware (Data Source)

Looks up a TrueNAS VMware snapshot integration entry by id. Never exposes the VMware host password: this datasource has no "password" attribute.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "truenas_vmware" "backup_coordination" {
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the VMware configuration to look up.

### Read-Only

- `datastore` (String) Valid datastore name which exists on the VMware host.
- `filesystem` (String) ZFS filesystem or dataset used for VMware storage.
- `hostname` (String) IP address / hostname of the VMware host.
- `state` (Attributes) Current connection and synchronization state with the VMware host. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--state))
- `username` (String) Credentials used to authorize access to the VMware host.

<a id="nestedatt--state"></a>
### Nested Schema for `state`

Read-Only:

- `datetime` (String) Timestamp of the last state update, if any.
- `error` (String) Error text from the last snapshot operation, if any.
- `state` (String) VMware host state (PENDING, SUCCESS, ERROR, or BLOCKED).
